data.body: Patch set 2 addressed LLM advisory comments by removing ineffective marker.fcntl monkeypatch tests, adding a meaningful NoExclusiveLegError no-unlock assertion against lock_kernel, and updating remove_marker's docstring. Re-validation after advisory fix: pytest tests/unit/test_marker_fcntl_guard.py -q (3 passed); pytest tests/unit/test_marker_fcntl_guard.py tests/unit -k marker -q (320 passed, 8 skipped); make lint; make typecheck; make verify exited 2 with only the known GIT_CONFIG repo-isolation artifact, and the mandated env-unset solo isolation test passed (13 passed). Gerrit change 2833 patch set 2 received LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1, then was submitted.
